description: Use publicly archived radiometrically calibrated LROC NAC CDR products corresponding to README-verified independent source acquisitions. Import calibrated pixels with pds2isis and add instrument metadata, run spiceinit with explicit kernels, orthorectify onto precommitted DTM grid and capture radiometry/projection provenance.
reason: The CDR IMG pair for FRSHCRATER10 / M153639872 has been downloaded, decoded as scaled I/F, and a left-camera image orthorectified to the DTM grid. Existing optical gate cannot rely on EDR-only discovery. Previous EDR-only assumption is obsolete, but protocol must not be edited retroactively.
unchanged_constraints: README source list must verify every camera acquisition, with zero source overlap with SomBench and prior used data
all new DTM footprints remain >=10 km from historic used and protected footprints
native DTM post spacing <=3 m under policy A; do not claim physical equivalence by interpolation
DTM-derived shade/slope/browse layers prohibited as NAC optical input
do not run model predictions or inspect heldout risk labels/results to choose scenes
old frozen product-level V2 files and their SHA256 unchanged
new_requirements: CDR image product ID/camera and its underlying acquisition must agree with PDS source README; record dataset version and hash
calibration model/scaling factor/NULL handling documented and image feature preprocessing compatible with train
ISIS+SPICE kernel paths/hash/versions and exact map-projection semantics recorded
registration QA with independent control features and per-scene residual distribution before freeze
union mosaic coverage over DTM valid footprint quantified, with original runbook >=95% target; reduced or tile-level gate requires separate preregistered approval
check for label leakage when orthorectification uses fine-resolution target DTM pixel elevations instead of independent coarse topography
multi-camera/multi-acquisition fusion method fixed before any model risk score is observed
